clips.end_words: in prison for saying the truth
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau wrote that talcum powder, the kind in Johnson's baby powder, was linked to cancer and hormone problems.

The government called it a lie. They said he was making false claims and scaring people for nothing.

He went to prison anyway, for exercising his First Amendment right to say what he believed was true.

Twenty years later, the science caught up. Talcum powder has since been tied to hormonal imbalances and proven to cause cancer, just like he said.

He served time for a truth the world wasn't ready to hear yet.

Would you risk prison to say what you believe?

#kevintrudeau #naturalcures #freespeech #truthteller #talcumpowder #mindset

The government told a judge that Kevin Trudeau was hiding $250 to $300 million somewhere offshore.

His response: if I actually had that kind of money, why would I risk ten years in prison instead of just writing a check?

So he did something most people accused of hiding money never do. He asked the FTC to bring in its own top forensic accountants and search everything himself, his banks, his books, his records, everywhere.

They flew to Switzerland. They interviewed his accountant of twenty years. They searched the whole world for the missing fortune.

They found nothing, because there was nothing to find.

Ever been accused of something you couldn't prove wasn't true?

#kevintrudeau #ftc #moneymindset #wealth #government #truth

clips.end_words: nothing to my name absolutely nothing
clips.caption:
After ten years in prison, Kevin Trudeau walked out with two suitcases and some old clothes. That's it.

No toothbrush. No money. No home. He moved into a friend's living room because he had nowhere else to go.

The gray t-shirt and sweatpants in his first photos after release came from the prison commissary. The shoes had holes in the soles. The socks were ripped.

He kept wearing those same clothes for years afterward, not out of nostalgia, but because he genuinely couldn't afford to replace them.

Rock bottom, for him, was starting over with nothing to his name.

If you had to rebuild from zero tomorrow, would you know where to start?

#kevintrudeau #startingover #resilience #prison #rockbottom #mindset

Kevin Trudeau's own lawyer warned him: you're probably going back to prison.

Kevin says he looked inward instead of panicking, and told his lawyer something good was about to happen.

Minutes later the judge walked in and said something nobody expected: I am biased against Mr. Trudeau, and I am recusing myself from this case. Then he left.

The FTC was stunned. His own lawyer was stunned. Kevin says he wasn't, because he'd already felt it coming.

He was reassigned to a Harvard-trained judge known for being fair and impossible to sway.

Do you trust your gut before the outcome even shows up?

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #mindset #yourwishisyourcommand #law #belief

clips.start_words: we gave them stacks of comments
clips.caption:
After waiting four months for a ruling, Kevin Trudeau's new judge finally came back with a 46-page decision.

Page after page said the same thing: I agree with Trudeau on this point. Then came the FTC's requests, one after another: denied, denied, denied.

Forty-six pages, and the government that spent years and tens of millions of dollars trying to put him back in prison got exactly nothing it asked for.

Right after that ruling, the FTC called and said it was time to settle.

Sometimes the system takes its time, but it still gets there.

Have you ever been patient enough to let the truth catch up?

#kevintrudeau #justice #patience #vindication #ftc #truth

clips.end_words: continue to beat him until he tells us
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau had just walked out of prison when the government dragged him right back into court.

Their own forensic expert had already said it: no hidden money anywhere in the world, every penny accounted for.

So the government asked the judge to send him back to prison anyway, to force him to reveal assets nobody could prove existed. Kevin's answer: I can't tell you where something is if it was never there.

He compared it to being told we'll keep beating you until you tell us where the invasion is, when you were never told where the invasion is.

That's prison time threatened over a secret that simply didn't exist.

Could you prove a negative if your freedom depended on it?

#kevintrudeau #justice #government #prison #freedom #truth
